subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should existing bundled skill descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger selection wait for a structured metadata/search contract?
rationale: Current source still uses description text as the prompt-visible selection signal, but docs require compact descriptions and related open issues propose structured triggers and smart indexing, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve compact description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that keeps each affected bundled skill description short, WHAT+WHEN oriented, and within current prompt-budget guidance.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact for now and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for explicit trigger metadata and exact-match routing.

options.title: Decline broad trigger wording
options.body: Document that concise descriptions are intentional and close or redirect broad trigger-copy PRs unless a specific skill description is demonstrably wrong.

recommendation.title: Approve compact description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that keeps each affected bundled skill description short, WHAT+WHEN oriented, and within current prompt-budget guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest current routing signal for published skill-authoring guidance and compact description expectations.
